text: Back in May, one post written in Morse code
tricked an AI agent into giving away over a hundred and fifty thousand US dollars.

Slide to approve, and the card's live.

That's because every payment goes through eight layers. Six run on our server and make the agent behave.

A stolen agent key still only pays your listed sellers, up to the cap. The guardian key can only freeze. Your owner key stays on your phone.
The second AI checks every seller and every payment.

It can only make your rules stricter, never looser.
